themeDescription: Data rights, digital footprint, online safety

days.title: Digital Footprint - Everything Online Leaves Traces
days.learning_objective: Understand that all online activity creates data traces that persist and may be accessed by others.

days.title: Data as Currency - Your Information Has Value
days.learning_objective: Recognize that personal data is valuable and understand how companies monetize user information.

days.title: Who Has Your Data - Understanding Data Collection
days.learning_objective: Identify the many entities that collect personal data and how they obtain it.

days.title: How Data Is Used - From Personalization to Manipulation
days.learning_objective: Understand the spectrum of data use from helpful personalization to harmful manipulation.

days.title: AI and Your Data - How AI Learns from You
days.learning_objective: Understand how AI systems use personal data for training and personalization.

days.title: Privacy Rights - What You're Entitled To
days.learning_objective: Learn about privacy rights and regulations that protect personal information.

days.title: Privacy Settings - Taking Control
days.learning_objective: Navigate privacy settings on devices, apps, and platforms to protect personal information.

days.title: Strong Passwords - Basic Digital Security
days.learning_objective: Create and manage strong passwords as the foundation of digital security.

days.title: Phishing and Scams - Recognizing Threats
days.learning_objective: Identify phishing attempts and online scams, and know how to respond safely.

days.title: Safe Sharing - What to Post, What to Keep Private
days.learning_objective: Develop judgment about what information is safe to share online versus what should remain private.

days.title: Reputation Online - Your Digital Identity
days.learning_objective: Understand how online presence shapes reputation and future opportunities.

days.title: Digital Wellness - Healthy Technology Use
days.learning_objective: Develop habits for healthy technology use that supports rather than undermines well-being.

days.title: Screen Time - Balance and Boundaries
days.learning_objective: Create healthy boundaries around screen time and digital device use.

days.title: Social Media - Benefits and Risks
days.learning_objective: Navigate social media mindfully, leveraging benefits while managing risks.

days.title: Online Communities - Finding Your People
days.learning_objective: Find and participate in healthy online communities that support learning and growth.

days.title: Digital Citizenship - Being a Good Online Citizen
days.learning_objective: Practice responsible, respectful, and constructive behavior in digital spaces.

days.title: Respect Online - Treating Others Well
days.learning_objective: Extend respect, empathy, and kindness to all people encountered online.

days.title: Cyberbullying - Recognizing and Responding
days.learning_objective: Recognize cyberbullying, respond appropriately, and support those affected.

days.title: Misinformation Online - Navigating False Information
days.learning_objective: Apply critical thinking to navigate misinformation and disinformation online.

days.title: Echo Chambers - Avoiding Filter Bubbles
days.learning_objective: Recognize and counteract echo chambers that limit exposure to diverse perspectives.

days.title: Digital Literacy - Essential Online Skills
days.learning_objective: Develop essential digital literacy skills for navigating the online world effectively.

days.title: Platform Awareness - How Social Platforms Work
days.learning_objective: Understand the business models and design choices that shape social platform behavior.

days.title: Algorithm Awareness - How Recommendations Work
days.learning_objective: Understand how recommendation algorithms shape what you see and influence behavior.

days.title: Advertising Awareness - Recognizing Paid Content
days.learning_objective: Identify advertising and sponsored content, even when disguised as organic.

days.title: Consent Online - Agreeing to Terms You Understand
days.learning_objective: Practice informed consent by understanding terms of service before agreeing.

days.title: Right to Be Forgotten - Removing Digital History
days.learning_objective: Understand the concept of the right to be forgotten and how to request data deletion.

days.title: Data Ownership - Who Owns Your Information
days.learning_objective: Explore questions of data ownership and rights to your own information.

days.title: Privacy Advocacy - Protecting Collective Privacy
days.learning_objective: Engage in advocacy for privacy protections that benefit everyone.

days.title: The Future of Privacy - Where Things Are Heading
days.learning_objective: Consider emerging privacy challenges and opportunities in a data-driven world.

days.title: Privacy Balance - Sharing vs Protecting
days.learning_objective: Find your personal balance between the benefits of sharing and the value of privacy.

days.title: Month in Review - Digital Citizenship in Practice
days.learning_objective: Integrate privacy and digital citizenship practices into daily online life.
